repo.description: owner/name or host/owner/name; default: this workspace's origin.

url.x-ace-constraint: Accept strings whose trimmed value is an absolute WHATWG URL. Whitespace, Unicode hosts, opaque schemes and parser-normalized URLs are allowed. x-ace-url-minLength and x-ace-url-maxLength apply after trimming whitespace and removing ASCII tab, CR and LF characters, using UTF-16 code units. Install the ace-whatwg-url format validator or enforce this rule in application code.

x-ace-constraint: Exactly one of url, number, or all: true; all only with unlink.
